display_title: The Star Becoming a Great One
description:
Byul-nim wakes up and finds out that he has changed his body with Daesu, who is himself in a parallel world. Byeol-nim thinks that unlike his original self, Kwon Dae-soo, a muscular man with a big chest and tall height, will not be able to lead a splendid life, and he wanders in search of a way to return to his original world. Will Byul-nim be able to take off Daesoo's mask and restore his original body?

**Original Webtoon:**
